params.name: model
params.description: Voice model to use for speech synthesis. Aura model family voices include aura-asteria-en, aura-luna-en, aura-stella-en, aura-athena-en, aura-hera-en, aura-orion-en, aura-arcas-en, aura-perseus-en, aura-angus-en, aura-orpheus-en, aura-helios-en, and aura-zeus-en.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Audio encoding format for the output. Options include linear16, mulaw, alaw, mp3, opus, flac, and aac.

params.name: container
params.description: File format container for the output audio. The default depends on the encoding selected.

params.name: sample_rate
params.description: Sample rate in Hertz for the output audio. Default is 24000. Valid values depend on the selected encoding.

params.name: bit_rate
params.description: Bit rate for compressed audio formats such as MP3 and Opus.

params.name: callback
params.description: URL to which Deepgram will send the audio when processing is complete.

params.name: callback_method
params.description: HTTP method for the callback request.

items.docs: Converts text content into natural-sounding speech audio using Deepgram's Aura model family. Returns audio data in the specified encoding format. Supports multiple voices and configurable audio output settings including encoding, sample rate, and container format.
